caption:
I spent 45 minutes chasing a rogue space. Python’s a surprisingly judgmental roommate. 🤯

Seriously, I was staring at my code, meticulously reviewing every line, convinced a logic error was lurking. Turns out, a single, solitary space was the culprit. 🤦‍♀️

Learning Python as a beginner is…an experience. It’s a masterclass in patience, and a constant reminder to triple-check your syntax. Don’t let a misplaced space derail your entire evening! 😅

Anyone else have a debugging horror story? Share in the comments! 👇
